regime: Reclaim and Stabilization (Risk-On Tone, Vol Easing)
summary: Yesterday's selloff got bought back. NQ flushed to a 29,622 low at the open, then reversed and climbed all session to close 30,077.75, down just 0.20 percent and well off the lows. MES recovered 0.27 percent to 7,786.25, and both reclaimed their trend stops. December gold found a safe-haven bid and rallied 1.60 percent to 4,192.9, while crude ripped 2.52 percent to 97.56, the strongest in the complex. VIX eased 2.4 percent to 16.46.

setups.bias: A textbook BIR day. MNQ broke the OR down, failed, and closed back inside, then trended up all session. BIR was eligible Thursday and this was its setup.

setups.bias: Price reclaimed and spent the back half of the day above AVWAP. The anchored mean flips to support, so dips into it favor the long while it holds.

setups.t1: Measured move to the prior highs.

event.name: No scheduled US release (budget and shutdown disruption continues)
event.consensus: The federal data calendar is still disrupted by the Washington budget and shutdown situation. October CPI and other scheduled releases remain delayed and may not print, so there is no reliable data catalyst.
event.actual: No major US release drove the tape. This was a positioning and flow-driven reclaim after yesterday's selloff.
event.surprise: The recovery itself was the story. A broad bid came back across stocks, gold and crude with no single headline, and VIX eased about 2.4 percent.
event.nqReaction: NQ gapped lower and flushed to a 29,622.25 low early, then reversed and climbed all session to a 30,197 high before fading to close 30,077.75, off 0.20 percent but well off the lows. A V-shaped recovery.
event.crossAsset: MES recovered to 7,786.25, up 0.27 percent and back above its stop. December gold rallied 1.60 percent to 4,192.9, the safe-haven bid returning. Crude ripped 2.52 percent to 97.56, the strongest in the complex. VIX 16.46, down 2.4 percent.

observe.name: OBSERVE lane
observe.note: No OBSERVE-lane signals today. GAP_NQ and TSMOM252LO_NQ sit outside the Net Alpha Pro curriculum and are tracked for research only.

risk.sizing: Reduced while the reclaim is one day old
risk.openRisk: Trend-long flipped back on across NQ, MES, gold and crude, but NQ and MES are still under EMA50, so the reclaim is unconfirmed.
risk.note: The tape reclaimed, but it is a single session off a sharp selloff and NQ and MES still sit below EMA50 and the prior big stops. Keep size reduced until a clean trend re-establishes, meaning a hold above today's stops (MNQ 29,789, MES 7,741, gold 4,159, crude 96.21) and a reclaim of the 30,197 NQ high. Crude is the cleanest long, above a rising stop after a 2.5 percent run, so trail it and do not chase 98. VIX eased to 16.46 but the range is still wide, so let the stops do the work. The data calendar stays disrupted by the shutdown, so treat any headline as the catalyst. Next policy event is the FOMC meeting Oct 27 to 28.

psychology: After a hard down day the urge is to stay bearish and fade every bounce. Today punished that. Price flushed to the lows, then recovered all session. Grade the setup in front of you and let the tape, not yesterday's fear, set the bias. A failed down-break that closes back inside the range is a reclaim signal, so respect it and let price prove the next trend before pressing. One green day off the lows does not make a new uptrend, so keep size honest and plan for a possible lower high.

fullReport.title: NY Opening Range / HTA OPEN (MNQ)
fullReport.html:
OR High 29,847.75 | OR Low 29,683.5 | Width 164 pts (0.55%)

Break DOWN at 13:50 UTC at 29,640, but the down-break failed. Price reversed and closed back above the range at 30,140.75, above NYVWAP 29,971.64. HOF VWAP 29,982.04.

It is Thursday, so no day-of-week blocks and BIR was eligible. This was its setup: a full-body close back inside the range after the false break, then a trend up the rest of the session.

A failed down-break that closes back inside the range is the Back-in-Range signal. The edge was fading the flush.

MNQ reclaims the 30,411 ATR stop on 2 hourly closesNOT TRIGGERED-MNQ never reclaimed 30,411. Its session high was 30,197, more than 200 points short. Price stayed below the old stop all day even as it recovered off the lows.
MNQ stays below 30,411 and loses the 30,078 session low on 2 closesTRIGGEREDMIXEDMNQ held below 30,411 and lost 30,078 on consecutive overnight closes (about 29,790 then 29,688), extending to a 29,622.25 low through the 30,000 target zone. Then it reversed hard, rallied all session and closed 30,077.75, right back at the prior low, giving the down move back. The target hit, the close was flat.
MES reclaims the 7,792 ATR stop on 2 hourly closesNOT TRIGGERED-MES did not reclaim 7,792 on 2 closes. Its best hourly closes topped near 7,790.75, just short. It lost the 7,741 RTH low to a 7,717.25 low, then recovered to close 7,786.25, still a touch under the stop.
December gold reclaims the 4,144 stop on 2 hourly closesTRIGGEREDPLAYED OUTGold reclaimed 4,144 early and held above it on back-to-back closes, then ran well past the 4,150 pause zone to a 4,197 high, closing 4,192.9, up 1.60 percent. The reclaim played out and extended.
Crude holds above the 94.34 rising stop and holds the 95 roundTRIGGEREDMIXEDCrude wicked below 94.34 overnight to 93.58 with a couple of closes under it, briefly tripping the trend-off condition, then reclaimed fast and ripped through 95 and the 96.07 target to a 98.36 high, closing 97.56, up 2.52 percent. The up thesis delivered big, but the overnight break of 94.34 made it mixed, not clean.
